_doc: Layer 1 of the best-time system (src/lib/bestTime.ts): what published studies say about when short vertical videos do best, per platform, in the AUDIENCE's local time (the app uses the channel's posting timezone, calendar.json → timezone_offset_min). Each day is a sum of bumps {at: hour, w: width in hours, h: height}; day_weight scales whole days (index 0 = Sunday). This is only the starting guess: Instagram's 'followers online' (layer 2) and the channel's own post results (layer 3) take over as data comes in. Studies disagree a lot (see notes), so this layer is deliberately gentle. Re-check the sources about once a year and update 'updated'.
audience: India, Hindi/Hinglish-speaking, mobile-first (evening-heavy); weekday studies from US/global data shifted to the evening peak that India-focused guides agree on

instagram.label: Instagram Reels
instagram.summary: Evenings 6-10 PM IST are the most agreed window for India; a smaller lunch bump; Tue-Thu slightly stronger.

sources.name: Later (975k Reels)
sources.finding: very early hours (5 AM) best on average

sources.name: Adobe (22k Reels from top creators)
sources.finding: noon most common; no universal best time, varies by category

youtube.label: YouTube Shorts
youtube.summary: Late afternoon to evening (4-9 PM local) in most studies; Friday, then Saturday and Thursday, are the strongest days.

sources.name: Buffer (1.8M videos)
sources.finding: Shorts: top slots Friday 4, 6 and 7 PM; then Saturday, Thursday

sources.name: YouTube (via study round-ups)
sources.finding: publish time is not known to affect long-term performance; it mostly shapes the first hours

facebook.label: Facebook Reels
facebook.summary: Midweek beats weekends (Wednesday best, Saturday weakest); daytime windows in global studies, evening for an Indian audience.

sources.name: Buffer (14M posts)
sources.finding: Thursday 9 AM best slot; Wednesday best day; Saturday worst

sources.name: Sprout Social 2025 (2.7B engagements)
sources.finding: 8-9 AM to 6 PM, Mon-Thu; newer edition Tue-Wed 12-8 PM
